Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study compares three different production methods for RBCEPs. EryEs serve as the natural/baseline control. NanoEs are produced via physical sonication (mechanical). VI-EryEs are produced via chemical stimulation using a calcium ionophore. The proteomics analysis specifically compares the protein content of these three groups.
